dossier_meta.catalog_title: Informal: Exponent in Theorem 1 not optimal
dossier_meta.statement_text: The dependence on $\Delta$ in the exponent of the bound $\mathbb{P}(\alpha \text{ is frozen}) \leq (6/7)^{n/(\Delta+1)}$ in Theorem 1 is not best possible.
dossier_meta.context_text: Theorem 1 gives the upper bound $(6/7)^{n/(\Delta+1)}$ on the probability a uniform random $(\Delta+1)$-colouring is frozen. Proposition 4 provides a matching lower bound with exponent $e^{-3\log(\Delta)/\Delta \cdot n}$, leaving a gap of a $\log\Delta$ factor. The authors believe the upper bound can be tightened to close this gap.
